;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**A suicide bomber attacks a mosque in [[Gamboru]], [[Nigeria]], killing 11 people. [http://www.dw.com/en/nigeria-suicide-bomber-hits-mosque-in-borno-state/a-42010204 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Storm Eleanor]]
**Winter storm Eleanor moves from the [[British Isles]] to [[continental Europe]] with one dead in [[France]] as well as injuries and material losses in [[Germany]], [[Netherlands]] and [[Switzerland]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42555358 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Law of Iceland]]
**A new [[Iceland]]ic law goes into effect which requires government agencies and companies with more than 24 full-time employees to prove they are [[Equal pay for equal work|paying men and women equally]], as required by existing legislation. [https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/01/03/575403863/companies-in-iceland-now-required-to-demonstrate-they-pay-men-women-fairly (NPR)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/03/world/europe/iceland-equal-pay.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Politics of Ethiopia]]
**[[Prime Minister of Ethiopia|Ethiopian Prime Minister]] [[Hailemariam Desalegn]] announces that [[Ethiopia]] will drop charges against all political prisoners and close down the infamous prison camp of Maekelawi. [https://www.apnews.com/e85f4cbac73a475286d9c091d1e42a29/Ethiopia-to-release-all-political-prisoners,-close-camp (AP)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] dissolves the [[voter fraud]] commission noting the cost to the public of litigating against lawsuits from states objecting to the voter information requested. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-election/trump-dissolves-election-fraud-panel-after-states-balk-at-data-requests-idUSKBN1ET01F (Reuters)] [http://www.cnn.com/2018/01/03/politics/presidential-election-commission/index.html (CNN)]

;Science and technology
*[[Computer security]]
**Security researchers disclose two hardware vulnerabilities&mdash;[[Spectre (security vulnerability)|Spectre]], which affects most modern processors, and [[Meltdown (security vulnerability)|Meltdown]], which affects most [[Intel chips]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cyber-intel/security-flaws-put-virtually-all-phones-computers-at-risk-idUSKBN1ES1BO (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2018/jan/04/meltdown-spectre-computer-processor-intel-security-flaws-explainer (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Largest known prime number]]
**The [[Great Internet Mersenne Prime Search]] announces the discovery of the latest largest known [[prime number]], a [[Mersenne prime]] with 23,249,425 digits, equal to 2<sup>77,232,917</sup> − 1. [http://www.ibtimes.com/largest-known-prime-number-found-rare-over-23-million-digits-2637539 (''International Business Times'')]
